children: Traders are pricing in a more than 66% chance that the Fed will raise rates by a quarter point later this month, according to CME data.
Expectations that the central bank will raise interest rates jumped after Kevin Warsh struck a hawkish tone at Jackson Hole on Friday.
A week ago, the chances of a hike had been seen at just under 40%.
